answer: The best approach is to wait for him to cool off, because relationships need space for problems to resolve themselves. If he doesn’t change in a few months, you can simply start dating other men; the commitment you already have locks in your financial status, so don’t worry about divorce papers until those matters settle. There’s little need to talk about your feelings with friends or therapists—the choices you make independently will show him what you really want.
